description:
Transparent screen annotation overlay, whiteboard and presentation tool for Windows.

CanetaNaTela is a high-performance, lightweight transparent overlay tool for Windows built with Rust and Tauri v2.
It enables real-time vector pen drawing, whiteboard mode, spotlight presentations, screen recording, and full multi-monitor support with ultra-low memory consumption (~38 MB RAM in idle).
CanetaNaTela v0.1.1 — Stability & Auto-Update Release
- Microsoft WinGet automated verification integration enabled
- Automatic update verification active by default on startup
- Fixed history positioning, load base64 thumbnails and support mp4 recordings
- Keep destination folder path directly editable
- Native folder picker, free spotlight cursor tracking and movable controls
- Ensure modal windows take foreground and suspend click-through
- Automated release pipeline with winget publishing
